description: This file is the main entry point for a backend web API service built with ASP.NET Core. It configures services, middleware, endpoints, health checks, API documentation, CORS, database connection setup, and request handling for asset management functions.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: DTO for the request payload of the validity check endpoint, requires a non-empty string 'Value'.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: DTO for the response of the validity check endpoint, indicating if input is valid and reasons if not.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists, supporting 'export KEY=VALUE' syntax and avoiding overwriting existing env vars.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL for API documentation, prioritizing environment override, then X-Forwarded headers, then fallback to request schemes.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures the OpenAPI (Swagger) document with the appropriate server URL based on request context.
